subject: Partial-year activation & true-up invoice plan for Quantify.ai
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura@quantify.ai>
To: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@quantify.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing question: multi-year prepay & partial activation

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looked great. Our procurement team is trying to finalize the commercials but we ran into a practical question on invoicing for a multi-year prepay.

Scenario: we plan to onboard in mid-Q3 (activation 15 Sep 2026) but the prepay is for a 2-year commitment starting 1 Sep 2026. Our auditors require a clear split between the portion of the prepay that covers the remainder of 2026 and the next calendar year. Can Redwood issue split invoices (pro-rated first-year invoice + full-year invoice for year two) and provide the amortization schedule/notes we can attach to our ASC 606 review?

Also: we may need a true-up at the end of year one if usage ramps faster than expected. Would love to understand how you typically structure the ramp true-up (billing timing, credits, or separate invoice).

Attached: SOW draft (internal reference) — happy to share a redline.

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of Procurement
Quantify.ai
[Attachment: Quantify_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura@quantify.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing question: multi-year prepay & partial activation

Hi Laura — thanks for surfacing this early, good question.

Short answer: yes, we can structure split invoicing for multi-year prepays. Below is the approach we recommend for scenarios with mid-period activation plus a potential ramp/true-up.

1) Activation invoice (pro-rated): issue an invoice at contract signature for the committed prepay amount, with an explicit line item that is allocated to the partial first-year period (e.g., 1 Sep–31 Dec 2026). This is what our billing ops teams call the Year0 pro-rate.

2) Year 1 invoice (annual billing schedule): issue a separate invoice for the following contract year (1 Jan–31 Dec 2027) either at the start of the year or at the contract anniversary depending on your preference.

3) True-up mechanics: if actual consumption exceeds the committed prepay during the measurement window, we typically do a single true-up invoice at the end of the 12-month measurement period. That invoice reflects overage at the contracted overage rate (or we apply crediting if you prefer to net it).

4) Accounting/ASC 606 notes: we can provide an amortization schedule showing deferred revenue allocation by reporting period and a short memo your auditors can use. Rishi and Marcus, can you attach the template and a sample memo?

I've attached the SOW you sent for internal reference and looped in Monica (CS) to coordinate the activation date and implementation milestones.

Next steps:
- Monica to confirm activation cutoff date and milestone calendar.
- Rishi/Marcus to provide invoice-split template and revenue recognition note.
- Laura to confirm preferred billing cadence (start-of-year vs. anniversary).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
[Attachment referenced: Quantify_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura@quantify.ai>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Billing question: multi-year prepay & partial activation

Folks — forwarding the recommended finance ops treatment.

Summary (finance perspective):
- Invoice flow we prefer:
  * Invoice A (At signature): total committed prepay amount, with accounting memo that X% is allocated to FY2026 (pro-rated days between activation and 12/31) and the balance to FY2027 onward.
  * Invoice B (Start of FY2027 or anniversary): subsequent year(s) invoice(s) for the contracted annual amount.
  * True-up Invoice (Annual, post measurement): if usage > committed, issue overage invoice and apply kernel-level credits as needed.

- Revenue recognition (practical):
  * Record deferred revenue at receipt.
  * Amortize to revenue using the pro-rated schedule (we'll provide the template).
  * For auditors: provide a memo referencing ASC 606: performance obligations are delivered over time; allocation keys = calendar days or agreed milestones.

- Evidence pack we can provide: SOW (signed), signed quote, amortization schedule (.xlsx), and a one-page accounting memo that states the allocation method and identifies the measurement windows.

I've attached the Invoice_Split_Template.xlsx (example allocations per month) and a short sample memo text in the sheet. Monica — please ensure activation date we pass to accounting is the implementation "go-live" date, not the kickoff call.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations Manager
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Invoice_Split_Template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Laura Chen <laura@quantify.ai>

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing question: multi-year prepay & partial activation

Thanks Mina/Marcus — this is helpful. A couple of clarifying points from our side:

- Our auditors prefer the amortization to be aligned to fiscal months (we use calendar months), so the prorate should be calculated by month boundaries where possible.
- For the true-up, can you confirm if Redwood will accept a credit to the following year's invoice rather than issuing a separate overage invoice? That would simplify our AP process.
- We also need the one-page accounting memo and the signed SOW to be included in the evidence pack. Can you include a sample amortization table that shows the first 6 months of allocation for our review?

We propose the ramp schedule below: 0–3 months light (10–20% of committed), months 4–12 linear ramp to 100% of committed. If that changes materially we will trigger the annual true-up.

If you can confirm the credit flow by EOD Tue (4 Aug), we can slot the PO and DocuSign for signature on Wed.

Appreciate it,
Laura
Head of Procurement, Quantify.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing question: multi-year prepay & partial activation — Plan & actions

Laura — thanks, we can confirm the following agreed plan and next actions. Pulling this into a single thread so procurement and finance have a written record.

Agreed invoice & accounting flow:
- Invoice 1 (At signature / prepay receipt): we will issue an invoice that calls out the total committed prepay. In the invoice line items we will include an allocation column showing the portion allocated to Sep–Dec 2026 (calculated by calendar month boundaries) and the balance allocated to FY2027.
- Invoice 2 (Start of FY2027 or contract anniversary — your choice): issue the annual invoice for the next period.
- True-up handling: Redwood will provide the option to net true-up as a credit against the following year's invoice (preferred by the customer) OR issue a separate overage invoice. Please indicate preference on the DocuSign.

Accounting deliverables we will attach to the evidence pack:
- Signed SOW (Quantify_SOW_v1.pdf)
- Invoice_Split_Template.xlsx (monthly allocation table; first 12 months populated)
- One-page accounting memo referencing ASC 606 and method used for allocation (calendar-month prorate).

Action items and owners:
- Monica Patel (CS): confirm go-live date (target 2026-09-15) and final milestone calendar by 2026-08-06.
- Rishi Malhotra (Finance): finalize the amortization table and accounting memo by 2026-08-05.
- Mina Haddad (Sales): prepare DocuSign with the PO lines and indicate the credit vs invoice preference checkbox by 2026-08-04 EOD.
- Laura / Quantify.ai: confirm preferred billing cadence (start-of-year vs anniversary) and whether you want the true-up netted as credit (please use the checkbox in DocuSign).

Links: HubSpot-23456 (opportunity), DocuSign-000321 (envelope will be sent once we have your billing cadence confirmation).

If there are any audit-specific wording requests from your auditors, send them through and Rishi will incorporate. Will follow up once Monica confirms the activation date.

Thanks all — quick phone call can be scheduled if needed.

Best,
